verses.original: Οὐ θέλω γὰρ ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν ἀδελφοί ὅτι οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν πάντες ὑπὸ τὴν νεφέλην ἦσαν καὶ πάντες διὰ τῆς θαλάσσης διῆλθον
verses.transliteration: Ou thelō gar hymas agnoein adelphoi hoti hoi pateres hēmōn pantes hypo tēn nephelēn ēsan kai pantes dia tēs thalassēs diēlthon
verses.literal: I do not want you to be unaware brothers that our forefathers were all under the cloud and that they all passed through the sea

verses.original: καὶ πάντες εἰς τὸν Μωϋσῆν ἐβαπτίσαντο ἐν τῇ νεφέλῃ καὶ ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ
verses.transliteration: kai pantes eis ton Mōusēn ebaptisanto en tē nephelē kai en tē thalassē
verses.literal: They were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea

verses.original: καὶ πάντες τὸ αὐτὸ πνευματικὸν βρῶμα ἔφαγον
verses.transliteration: kai pantes to auto pneumatikon brōma ephagon
verses.literal: They all ate the same spiritual food

verses.original: καὶ πάντες τὸ αὐτὸ πνευματικὸν ἔπιον πόμα ἔπινον γὰρ ἐκ πνευματικῆς ἀκολουθούσης πέτρας ἡ πέτρα δὲ ἦν ὁ Χριστός
verses.transliteration: kai pantes to auto pneumatikon epion poma epinon gar ek pneumatikēs akolouthousēs petras hē petra de ēn ho Christos
verses.literal: and drank the same spiritual drink for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them and that rock was Christ

verses.original: ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐν τοῖς πλείοσιν αὐτῶν εὐδόκησεν ὁ Θεός κατεστρώθησαν γὰρ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ
verses.transliteration: all’ ouk en tois pleiosin autōn eudokēsen ho Theos katestrōthēsan gar en tē erēmō
verses.literal: Nevertheless God was not pleased with most of them for they were struck down in the wilderness

verses.original: Ταῦτα δὲ τύποι ἡμῶν ἐγενήθησαν εἰς τὸ μὴ εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἐπιθυμητὰς κακῶν καθὼς κἀκεῖνοι ἐπεθύμησαν
verses.transliteration: Tauta de typoi hēmōn egenēthēsan eis to mē einai hēmas epithymētas kakōn kathōs kakeinoi epethymēsan
verses.literal: These things took place as examples to keep us from craving evil things as they did

verses.original: μηδὲ εἰδωλολάτραι γίνεσθε καθώς τινες αὐτῶν ὥσπερ γέγραπται Ἐκάθισεν ὁ λαὸς φαγεῖν καὶ πεῖν καὶ ἀνέστησαν παίζειν
verses.transliteration: mēde eidōlolatrai ginesthe kathōs tines autōn hōsper gegraptai Ekathisen ho laos phagein kai pein kai anestēsan paizein
verses.literal: Do not be idolaters as some of them were As it is written The people sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry

verses.original: μηδὲ πορνεύωμεν καθώς τινες αὐτῶν ἐπόρνευσαν καὶ ἔπεσαν μιᾷ ἡμέρᾳ εἰκοσι τρεῖς χιλιάδες
verses.transliteration: mēde porneuōmen kathōs tines autōn eporneusan kai epesan mia hēmera eikosi treis chiliades
verses.literal: We should not commit sexual immorality as some of them did and in one day twenty-three . . . thousand of them died

verses.original: μηδὲ ἐκπειράζωμεν τὸν Χριστόν καθώς τινες αὐτῶν ἐπείρασαν καὶ ὑπὸ τῶν ὄφεων ἀπώλλυντο
verses.transliteration: mēde ekpeirazōmen ton Christon kathōs tines autōn epeirasan kai hypo tōn opheōn apōllynto
verses.literal: We should not test Christ as some of them did and were killed by snakes

verses.original: μηδὲ γογγύζετε καθάπερ τινὲς αὐτῶν ἐγόγγυσαν καὶ ἀπώλοντο ὑπὸ τοῦ ὀλοθρευτοῦ
verses.transliteration: mēde gongyzete kathaper tines autōn egongysan kai apōlonto hypo tou olothreutou
verses.literal: And do not complain as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel

verses.original: Ταῦτα δὲ τυπικῶς συνέβαινεν ἐκείνοις ἐγράφη δὲ πρὸς νουθεσίαν ἡμῶν εἰς οὓς τὰ τέλη τῶν αἰώνων κατήντηκεν
verses.transliteration: Tauta de typikōs synebainen ekeinois egraphē de pros nouthesian hēmōn eis hous ta telē tōn aiōnōn katēntēken
verses.literal: Now these things happened to them as examples and were written down as warnings for us on whom the fulfillment of the ages has come

verses.original: Ὥστε ὁ δοκῶν ἑστάναι βλεπέτω μὴ πέσῃ
verses.transliteration: Hōste ho dokōn hestanai blepetō mē pesē
verses.literal: So the one who thinks he is standing firm should be careful not to fall

verses.original: πειρασμὸς ὑμᾶς οὐκ εἴληφεν εἰ μὴ ἀνθρώπινος πιστὸς δὲ ὁ Θεός ὃς οὐκ ἐάσει ὑμᾶς πειρασθῆναι ὑπὲρ ὃ δύνασθε ἀλλὰ ποιήσει σὺν τῷ πειρασμῷ καὶ τὴν ἔκβασιν τοῦ δύνασθαι ὑπενεγκεῖν
verses.transliteration: peirasmos hymas ouk eilēphen ei mē anthrōpinos pistos de ho Theos hos ouk easei hymas peirasthēnai hyper ho dynasthe alla poiēsei syn tō peirasmō kai tēn ekbasin tou dynasthai hypenenkein
verses.literal: No temptation has seized you except . . . what is common to man And God is faithful He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear But when you are tempted He will also provide . . . an escape so that you can stand up under it

verses.original: Διόπερ ἀγαπητοί μου φεύγετε ἀπὸ τῆς εἰδωλολατρίας
verses.transliteration: Dioper agapētoi mou pheugete apo tēs eidōlolatrias
verses.literal: Therefore my beloved flee from idolatry

verses.original: ὡς φρονίμοις λέγω κρίνατε ὑμεῖς ὅ φημι
verses.transliteration: hōs phronimois legō krinate hymeis ho phēmi
verses.literal: I speak . . . to reasonable people judge for yourselves what I say

verses.original: Τὸ ποτήριον τῆς εὐλογίας ὃ εὐλογοῦμεν οὐχὶ κοινωνία ἐστὶν τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ τὸν ἄρτον ὃν κλῶμεν οὐχὶ κοινωνία τοῦ σώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: To potērion tēs eulogias ho eulogoumen ouchi koinōnia estin tou haimatos tou Christou ton arton hon klōmen ouchi koinōnia tou sōmatos tou Christou estin
verses.literal: Is not the cup of blessing that we bless a participation in the blood of Christ And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ

verses.original: ὅτι εἷς ἄρτος ἓν σῶμα οἱ πολλοί ἐσμεν οἱ γὰρ πάντες ἐκ τοῦ ἑνὸς ἄρτου μετέχομεν
verses.transliteration: hoti heis artos hen sōma hoi polloi esmen hoi gar pantes ek tou henos artou metechomen
verses.literal: Because there is one loaf we who are many are one body for we all partake of the one loaf

verses.original: βλέπετε τὸν Ἰσραὴλ κατὰ σάρκα οὐχ οἱ ἐσθίοντες τὰς θυσίας κοινωνοὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου εἰσίν
verses.transliteration: blepete ton Israēl kata sarka ouch hoi esthiontes tas thysias koinōnoi tou thysiastēriou eisin
verses.literal: Consider the people of Israel Are not those who eat the sacrifices fellow partakers in the altar

verses.original: Τί οὖν φημι ὅτι εἰδωλόθυτόν τί ἐστιν ἢ ὅτι εἴδωλόν τί ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Ti oun phēmi hoti eidōlothyton ti estin ē hoti eidōlon ti estin
verses.literal: Am I suggesting then that food sacrificed to an idol is anything or that an idol is anything

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὅτι ἃ θύουσιν τὰ ἔθνη δαιμονίοις καὶ οὐ Θεῷ θύουσιν οὐ θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς κοινωνοὺς τῶν δαιμονίων γίνεσθαι
verses.transliteration: all’ hoti ha thyousin ta ethnē daimoniois kai ou Theō thyousin ou thelō de hymas koinōnous tōn daimoniōn ginesthai
verses.literal: No but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons not to God And I do not want you to be participants with demons

verses.original: οὐ δύνασθε ποτήριον Κυρίου πίνειν καὶ ποτήριον δαιμονίων οὐ δύνασθε τραπέζης Κυρίου μετέχειν καὶ τραπέζης δαιμονίων
verses.transliteration: ou dynasthe potērion Kyriou pinein kai potērion daimoniōn ou dynasthe trapezēs Kyriou metechein kai trapezēs daimoniōn
verses.literal: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons too you cannot partake in the table of the Lord and the table of demons too

verses.original: ἢ παραζηλοῦμεν τὸν Κύριον μὴ ἰσχυρότεροι αὐτοῦ ἐσμεν
verses.transliteration: ē parazēloumen ton Kyrion mē ischyroteroi autou esmen
verses.literal: Are we trying to provoke the Lord to jealousy Are we . . . stronger than He

verses.original: Πάντα ἔξεστιν ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντα συμφέρει Πάντα ἔξεστιν ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντα οἰκοδομεῖ
verses.transliteration: Panta exestin all’ ou panta sympherei Panta exestin all’ ou panta oikodomei
verses.literal: Everything is permissible but not everything is beneficial Everything is permissible but not everything is edifying

verses.original: μηδεὶς τὸ ἑαυτοῦ ζητείτω ἀλλὰ τὸ τοῦ ἑτέρου
verses.transliteration: mēdeis to heautou zēteitō alla to tou heterou
verses.literal: No one should seek his own good but the good of others

verses.original: Πᾶν τὸ ἐν μακέλλῳ πωλούμενον ἐσθίετε μηδὲν ἀνακρίνοντες διὰ τὴν συνείδησιν
verses.transliteration: Pan to en makellō pōloumenon esthiete mēden anakrinontes dia tēn syneidēsin
verses.literal: Eat anything sold in the meat market without raising questions of conscience

verses.original: Τοῦ Κυρίου γὰρ Ἡ γῆ καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Tou Kyriou gar Hē gē kai to plērōma autēs
verses.literal: for The earth is the Lord’s and the fullness thereof

verses.original: Εἴ τις καλεῖ ὑμᾶς τῶν ἀπίστων καὶ θέλετε πορεύεσθαι πᾶν τὸ παρατιθέμενον ὑμῖν ἐσθίετε μηδὲν ἀνακρίνοντες διὰ τὴν συνείδησιν
verses.transliteration: Ei tis kalei hymas tōn apistōn kai thelete poreuesthai pan to paratithemenon hymin esthiete mēden anakrinontes dia tēn syneidēsin
verses.literal: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go eat anything set before you without raising questions of conscience

verses.original: ἐὰν δέ τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ Τοῦτο ἱερόθυτόν ἐστιν μὴ ἐσθίετε δι’ ἐκεῖνον τὸν μηνύσαντα καὶ τὴν συνείδησιν
verses.transliteration: ean de tis hymin eipē Touto hierothyton estin mē esthiete di’ ekeinon ton mēnysanta kai tēn syneidēsin
verses.literal: But if someone tells you This food was offered to idols then do not eat it for the sake of the one who told you and for the sake of conscience

verses.original: συνείδησιν δὲ λέγω οὐχὶ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἀλλὰ τὴν τοῦ ἑτέρου ἵνα‿ τί γὰρ ἡ ἐλευθερία μου κρίνεται ὑπὸ ἄλλης συνειδήσεως
verses.transliteration: syneidēsin de legō ouchi tēn heautou alla tēn tou heterou hina ti gar hē eleutheria mou krinetai hypo allēs syneidēseōs
verses.literal: the other one’s conscience I mean not your own For why . . . should my freedom be determined by someone else’s conscience

verses.original: εἰ ἐγὼ χάριτι μετέχω τί βλασφημοῦμαι ὑπὲρ οὗ ἐγὼ εὐχαριστῶ
verses.transliteration: ei egō chariti metechō ti blasphēmoumai hyper hou egō eucharistō
verses.literal: If I partake in the meal with thankfulness why am I denounced because of that for which I give thanks

verses.original: Εἴτε οὖν ἐσθίετε εἴτε πίνετε εἴτε τι ποιεῖτε πάντα εἰς δόξαν Θεοῦ ποιεῖτε
verses.transliteration: Eite oun esthiete eite pinete eite ti poieite panta eis doxan Theou poieite
verses.literal: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do do it all to the glory of God

verses.original: ἀπρόσκοποι καὶ Ἰουδαίοις γίνεσθε καὶ Ἕλλησιν καὶ τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: aproskopoi kai Ioudaiois ginesthe kai Hellēsin kai tē ekklēsia tou Theou
verses.literal: Do not become a stumbling block . . . whether to Jews or Greeks or the church of God

verses.original: καθὼς κἀγὼ πάντα πᾶσιν ἀρέσκω μὴ ζητῶν τὸ ἐμαυτοῦ σύμφορον ἀλλὰ τὸ τῶν πολλῶν ἵνα σωθῶσιν
verses.transliteration: kathōs kagō panta pasin areskō mē zētōn to emautou symphoron alla to tōn pollōn hina sōthōsin
verses.literal: as I also try to please everyone in all I do For I am not seeking my own good but the good of many that they may be saved
